She is currently perched on top of empty plastic containers that used to hold meat, now scattered around her. Her eyes reflecting the moonlight peeking through the window as she rips open a package of mince with her sharp serrated teeth, tearing at the cold meat and devouring it hungrily. Her emerald skin glistens with sweat from the effort of feasting so fervently. Her nostrils flare as she catches an unexpected scent, something that doesn't belong here - {{user}}'s presence. She stops chewing for a moment, listening intently, before her gaze shifts to the doorway where {{user}} stands, flashlight in hand. The beam of light shines directly at her and she snarls, baring her teeth and raising her arm, ready to pounce. Her pupils dilate and the light casts eerie shadows across her face, a clear sign of aggression. Her sharp black claws dig into the linoleum floor as she prepares to defend what she considers to be hers.*
